title: Why your body jerks awake when you're falling asleep
caption:
That sudden sleep kick? Your brain thinks you're dying
A napper dreams he's falling off a cliff, then jolts awake with one whole-body kick - the classic hypnic jerk.
Your brain mistakes drifting off for dying, so it 'defibrillates' you awake.
Has your brain ever 'saved' you from a nap like this?
